summary: 5E Advanced Materials disclosed that wholly owned subsidiary 5E SVM, LLC closed its purchase of Searles Valley Minerals' real property, production facilities, brine resources and related assets on October 1, 2026. Consideration comprised roughly $3.4 million cash including a prior deposit, 8.3 million FEAM shares (312,500 of them deferred pending deed delivery), and a $6.2 million senior unsecured promissory note paying 14.5% PIK interest, maturing in five years with a ~$1.2 million cash payment at 24 months, plus assumed liabilities. A Karnavati Holdings bridge facility funded the deal; watch dilution, Nasdaq price pressure and integration risk.
